title: Best Razor Blades (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Products were selected from the cited sources: consumer reviews, expert testing, and community forums. The Gillette ProGlide Shield and Schick Quattro Titanium were chosen from TechGearLab; GSB Blade, Merkur Super Iridium, and Kai Captain Platinum were chosen from BadgerAndBlade.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so cost comparisons are based on relative value and feature sets.
